The business generates after-tax unlevered free cash flows of one hundred and fourteen, three hundred and ninety-six and eight hundred and sixty-four million dollars at the ends of the next three years. These are its only remaining operating cash flows, with no terminal proceeds. Use an effective annual discount rate of twenty percent and year-end discounting. Current market-value debt is two hundred and fifty million dollars, excess cash is twenty-five million dollars, and there are seventy million fully diluted common shares with no other claims. What is common value per share, in dollars?

follow_up.question: Why is enterprise value not the amount available to common shareholders?
follow_up.reference: Other capital providers have claims ahead of or alongside common equity. Deduct those non-equity claims and add non-operating assets before dividing the common residual by the share count.
